name: google-ads
description: Example remote MCP connector metadata for ChatGPT / OpenAI APIs. ChatGPT does not launch local stdio servers directly.
notes: Deploy google-ads-mcp with --transport streamable-http behind HTTPS.
Or keep the server private and use OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel with a tunnel_id.
Never put Google Ads credentials in this file — inject them into the server runtime only.
